claims.claim: REAL physics bowling strike on the emulator: a thrown ball rolls down the lane and knocks the pins down
claims.attestation: I LOOKED: a lit wood lane with gutters, a polished dark metallic ball, and 10 white pins in a triangle. On the 'bowl' command the ball rolled the length of the lane (read-back z=-2.95 -> -5.49 -> -7.27, y dropping to lane level) and KNOCKED THE PINS DOWN — only ~4 remain standing; the ball rolled off the end.
